definitions.explanation: Remaining in one position without moving. Implies patience or endurance.
Looking at something without looking away. Staring or gazing.
Enduring a situation without complaint or action.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧じっと⟦{見|み}ていました→見る：00283_miru⟧。

examples.english: There's nothing to do but wait patiently until the results come out.

notes:
じっと is an adverb describing stillness, fixedness, or patient endurance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- じっと{見|み}る (stare at)
- じっと{待|ま}つ (wait patiently)
- じっと{我慢|がまん}する (endure patiently)
- じっとしている (stay still)

POSITION: Usually placed directly before the verb it modifies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- じっくり: carefully, thoroughly (taking time)
- じっと: still, motionlessly (physical stillness)
